tools.name: show_flight_options
tools.title: Show flight options
tools.description: Searches flights and returns them as an interactive A2UI surface the user can pick from, instead of a list of text. Use whenever the user is choosing a flight.

origin.description: Departure airport code. Required — the trip is not priced without one.

surface.description: Where this surface will be placed. 'inline' (default) answers the current message; 'sidebar' is a persistent panel of controls; 'home' is a standing summary. It changes what is composed, not just where it goes.

tools.name: show_hotel_options
tools.title: Show places to stay
tools.description: Searches stays and returns them as A2UI hotel cards with rating, neighbourhood and nightly rate.

surface.description: Where this surface will be placed. 'inline' (default) answers the current message; 'sidebar' is a persistent panel of controls; 'home' is a standing summary. It changes what is composed, not just where it goes.

tools.name: show_trip_controls
tools.title: Show trip controls (sidebar)
tools.description: Returns the sidebar flow: a panel of controls for the trip as a whole — dates, party size, budget, stop preference — with one commit action. Use it when the user wants to *adjust* the trip rather than discuss it. The panel replaces itself each time; it is not a feed.

tools.name: show_itinerary
tools.title: Show a day-by-day itinerary
tools.description: Builds a day-by-day plan for a destination from its real highlights and returns it as an A2UI itinerary the user can tap through.

surface.description: Where this surface will be placed. 'inline' (default) answers the current message; 'sidebar' is a persistent panel of controls; 'home' is a standing summary. It changes what is composed, not just where it goes.

tools.name: show_trip_dashboard
tools.title: Show a trip dashboard
tools.description: Returns a generated dashboard for a trip: days remaining, budget used, forecast and a map of what is planned. Use for "how is my trip looking" questions.

tools.name: show_price_summary
tools.title: Show what a trip costs
tools.description: Returns an itemised cost breakdown and total as an A2UI price summary.

surface.description: Where this surface will be placed. 'inline' (default) answers the current message; 'sidebar' is a persistent panel of controls; 'home' is a standing summary. It changes what is composed, not just where it goes.
